description: Look up official CBAM default embedded emissions by CN/TARIC code, origin and year. Use this for gross cost estimates; cbam_get_certificate_price returns only the price and cbam_list_countries discovers named country tables. Prefixes expand to at most 100 matches; truncated flags omitted rows. Country defaults to OTHER; UNKNOWN selects Annex IV precursors. Returns matches with tCO2e/tonne, markup, gross EUR/tonne, certificate_price and regulation sources; excludes indirect emissions and electricity. No matching good returns not_a_cbam_good. Values are bundled from the cited acts, not live Registry calculations. Free keyless allowance: 10 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

cn.description: CN/TARIC code or prefix, 2 to 10 digits after removing spaces and dots; e.g. 7208 or 2523900010

country.description: Origin: two-letter ISO code (case-insensitive), e.g. IN, or OTHER (default), or UNKNOWN for Annex IV

year.description: Four-digit year, 2026 to 2100 inclusive, e.g. 2026; defaults to current UTC year (at least 2026)

name: cbam_get_default_values
title: Get CBAM default emission values
